class.name: LuaRuntime
class.brief_description: Embedded Lua 5.4 runtime for syntax checking and protected script execution.
class.description: Each instance owns a separate Lua state. The runtime opens a restricted standard-library set and enforces a Lua VM instruction-count budget during execution.

method.name: check_syntax
method.description: Compiles source without executing it. Returns ok, error, line, and kind fields.

method.name: execute_string
method.description: Executes source with a protected Lua call and returns structured diagnostics.

method.name: check_file
method.description: Reads a source file and compiles it without execution.

method.name: execute_file
method.description: Reads a source file and executes it with a protected call.

method.name: reset
method.description: Recreates the Lua state and clears globals.

method.name: set_instruction_budget
method.description: Sets the VM instruction budget for each execution.

method.name: get_instruction_budget
method.description: Returns the configured VM instruction budget.
